briefdescription.para: Start an asynchronous background retention-enforcement job.

detaileddescription.para: The background thread wakes up every interval, calls entity_provider for each registered policy, and applies archive / purge handlers as appropriate. Call stopBackgroundJob() to stop it.
Only one background job may run at a time. Calling startBackgroundJob() while a job is already running is a no-op.
